summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on experience building and debugging production-style robotics software in C++ and Python across perception, embedded controls, and system integration. Deployed a multi-component pick-and-place robot integrating TensorRT-optimized perception, closed-loop servo control, and sensor fusion, resolving 11 integration failures through systematic root-cause debugging to reach 100% pick reliability. Comfortable working end-to-end on Linux across hardware interfacing, real-time debugging, and on-robot validation.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free control, integrating ADXL345 accelerometer sensors with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF motion into real-time control commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; debugged and resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback control.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system as a three-layer distributed pipeline (mobile client, edge server, Jetson+Arduino controller) over a unified WebSocket fabric — system integration across perception, planning, and controls.
Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO perception (5.2x speedup: 56.7->10.9ms, 17.6->92 FPS) for visual servoing and dual ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping via I2C multiplexing.

Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) through systematic root-cause debugging and testing; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Deployed the Jetson-side controller as a systemd service (auto-restart, non-root isolation, static-IP networking) for reliable on-robot validation across devices.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson for real-time object detection and tracking, sending control commands to an STM32 microcontroller over UART for embedded systems integration.
Implemented multi-servo PWM closed-loop control with interrupt-driven UART command handling and user override for safe operation.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Built closed-loop heading correction for a 4-wheel holonomic robot: derived heading from dual-axis quadrature encoder odometry and fed angular error back into rotation control, holding course during translation.
Implemented interrupt-driven quadrature decoding from first principles (4-bit A/B transition state machine) and drove four motor channels at 15kHz PWM.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed forward kinematic chains for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
